description_target.target_text: Whenever two same-colored vertical bars have the same height and align on the same rows, fill the whole rectangle spanning those bars with that same color.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define square2 (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
    (define diag2-shapes (list (list (list 0 0) (list 1 1))
                               (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0))))
    (define t-shapes
      (list (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 0 2) (list 1 1))
            (list (list 0 0) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 2 0))
            (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 1 2))
            (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 2 1))))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (norm-cells cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<))
    (define (last-list xs) (if (empty? (rest xs)) (first xs) (last-list (rest xs))))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (objs-color grid color) (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) (objects grid 0)))
    (define (paint-obj grid obj color) (paint-cells grid (obj-cells obj) color))
    (define (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r1 c))
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r2 c))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c1))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c2)))))
    (define (rect-outline? obj)
      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj)) (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
             (cells (obj-cells obj))
             (expected (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2)))
        (and (>= (- r2 r1) 2)
             (>= (- c2 c1) 2)
             (= (length cells) (length expected))
             (all? (lambda (p) (member? p cells)) expected))))
    (define (solid-rect? obj)
      (= (obj-size obj)
         (* (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)))
            (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj))))))
    (define (bbox< a b)
      (cond [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
            [(not (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]
            [(not (= (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b))) (< (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b))]
            [else (< (obj-c2 a) (obj-c2 b))]))
    (define (shape-member? shape shapes) (member? shape shapes))
    (define (rotate-norm shape times)
      (if (= (modulo times 4) 0)
          shape
          (let* ((maxr (apply max (map first shape)))
                 (h (+ maxr 1))
                 (rotated (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) shape)))
            (rotate-norm (norm-cells rotated) (- times 1)))))
    (define (center-distance2 obj)
      (+ (abs (- (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) (- (rows g) 1)))
         (abs (- (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) (- (cols g) 1)))))
    (define (bar? obj)
      (and (= (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj))
           (= (obj-size obj) (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj))))
           (>= (obj-size obj) 2)))
    (define (bar-key bar) (list (obj-color bar) (obj-r1 bar) (obj-r2 bar)))
    (define (same-key? a b) (and (= (first a) (first b)) (= (second a) (second b)) (= (third a) (third b))))
    (define (unique-keys keys)
      (let loop ([remaining keys] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(empty? remaining) acc]
              [(any? (lambda (k) (same-key? k (first remaining))) acc) (loop (rest remaining) acc)]
              [else (loop (rest remaining) (append acc (list (first remaining))))])))
    (define (degree-in-cells p cells)
      (length (filter (lambda (d) (member? (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) cells))
                      cardinal-deltas)))
    (define (count-nonzero-rect grid r0 c0 h w)
      (for*/sum ([r (in-range r0 (+ r0 h))]
                 [c (in-range c0 (+ c0 w))])
        (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1)))
    (define (col-all-zero? grid c)
      (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 0)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
    (define (col-left-nonzero? grid c)
      (any? (lambda (r)
              (any? (lambda (cc) (not (= (at grid r cc) 0))) (range 0 c)))
            (range 0 (rows grid))))
    (define (col-right-nonzero? grid c)
      (any? (lambda (r)
              (any? (lambda (cc) (not (= (at grid r cc) 0))) (range (+ c 1) (cols grid))))
            (range 0 (rows grid))))
    (define (choose-sep-col grid)
      (let* ((cands (filter (lambda (c)
                              (and (col-all-zero? grid c)
                                   (col-left-nonzero? grid c)
                                   (col-right-nonzero? grid c)))
                            (range 0 (cols grid)))))
        (first (sort cands
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (let ((da (abs (- (* 2 a) (cols grid))))
                             (db (abs (- (* 2 b) (cols grid)))))
                         (if (= da db) (< a b) (< da db))))))))
    (define (interior-markers grid frame)
      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 frame)) (c1 (obj-c1 frame)) (r2 (obj-r2 frame)) (c2 (obj-c2 frame))
             (hits (for*/list ([r (in-range (+ r1 1) r2)]
                               [c (in-range (+ c1 1) c2)])
                     (list r c (at grid r c)))))
        hits))
    (define (find-interior-8 grid frame)
      (let ((hits (filter (lambda (m) (= (third m) 8)) (interior-markers grid frame))))
        (if (empty? hits) #f (last-list hits))))
    (define (find-interior-colored grid frame)
      (let ((hits (filter (lambda (m) (not (member? (third m) (list 0 5)))) (interior-markers grid frame))))
        (if (empty? hits) #f (last-list hits))))
    (define (corner-rot marker frame)
      (let ((r (first marker)) (c (second marker))
            (r1 (obj-r1 frame)) (c1 (obj-c1 frame)) (r2 (obj-r2 frame)) (c2 (obj-c2 frame)))
        (cond [(and (= r (+ r1 1)) (= c (+ c1 1))) 0]
              [(and (= r (+ r1 1)) (= c (- c2 1))) 1]
              [(and (= r (- r2 1)) (= c (- c2 1))) 2]
              [else 3])))
    (define (sample-right-of-shape grid obj sep)
      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
             (hits (filter (lambda (v) (not (member? v (list 0 1))))
                           (for*/list ([r (in-range (max 0 (- r1 1)) (min (rows grid) (+ r2 2)))]
                                        [c (in-range (+ c2 1) sep)])
                             (at grid r c)))))
        (if (empty? hits) #f (last-list hits))))

    (let* ((bars (filter bar? (objects g 0)))
           (keys (unique-keys (map bar-key bars))))
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([key (in-list keys)])
        (let* ((matching (filter (lambda (bar) (same-key? (bar-key bar) key)) bars))
               (cols (sort (map obj-c1 matching) <))
               (color (first key)) (r1 (second key)) (r2 (third key)))
          (let pair-loop ([remaining cols] [acc out])
            (if (< (length remaining) 2)
                acc
                (let ((c1 (first remaining)) (c2 (second remaining)))
                  (pair-loop
                   (rest (rest remaining))
                   (for*/fold ([a acc])
                              ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]
                               [c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))])
                     (set-cell a r c color)))))))))
  ))
